text:
I'm sorry for the worry. Per our policy, we can open a courier investigation once tracking hasn't moved for **4 business days**, so at 2 business days it's too early to start one. Tracking can also take up to 24 hours to update after shipping, so it may still move.

If it still hasn't updated after 4 business days, or it shows delivered but nothing arrived, contact us again and we'll open an investigation, which takes up to **5 business days**. If the parcel is confirmed lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.
